axes.yDefinition: log10 median H2-to-stellar mass ratio MH2/M*, converted from the plotted log10 MH2/(MH2+M*) (galaxies above the COLD GASS detection limit only)

selection.population: galaxies with M*>1e10 Msun and MH2 above the COLD GASS sensitivity limit
selection.warning: The median H2 fraction of galaxies with M*>1e10 Msun above the COLD GASS detection limit, GK11 prescription, read from the vector paths of Lagos et al. 2015; no table exists. The plotted quantity MH2/(MH2+M*) was converted exactly to MH2/M*. The sample is selected on detectability (M*>1e10 Msun, MH2 above the COLD GASS limit), so it is a biased subset, not the all-galaxy median. The 16th-84th percentile region (a hatched fill) and the COLD GASS observations are not extracted.
